title: Account
subtitle: Manage your account settings and privacy.

unauthenticated.title: Account Settings
unauthenticated.description: Sign in to access your account settings.

emailPrefs.sectionDescription: Choose which emails Payverge sends you. These apply to your whole account.
emailPrefs.errorMessage: We couldn't load your email preferences. Refresh the page or try again shortly.
emailPrefs.saveErrorToast: We couldn't save that change. Please try again.

transactional.label: Account & transactional
transactional.description: Essential emails about your account, orders, and payments.

notifications.sectionDescription: Order, reservation, and Telegram alerts are configured per business. Open a business to manage its alerts.
notifications.emptyDescription: Once you create a business, you can manage its per-business alerts here.
notifications.errorMessage: We couldn't load your businesses. Refresh the page or try again shortly.

privacy.sectionDescription: Download a copy of your Payverge account data or request that we delete it.
privacy.exportDescription: We will assemble a JSON snapshot of your profile and the businesses you own.
privacy.exportSuccess: Your export was downloaded. Snapshot is valid for 24 hours — re-run the export if you need fresher data.
privacy.exportError: We couldn't prepare your export. Please try again or contact support if the issue persists.
privacy.deleteDescription: Disables your account and starts a 30-day review window. Some tax, fiscal, billing, fraud, security, or legal records may need to be retained.
privacy.modalIntro: This disables your account and sets a deletion-review date 30 days from now. Final deletion is reviewed because some records may need to be retained. Type the value below to confirm.
privacy.modalConfirmLabel: Type your account email to confirm
privacy.modalReasonPlaceholder: What's prompting you to delete? (helps us improve)
privacy.modalError: Account deletion failed. Make sure the confirmation matches and try again.
privacy.modalSuccess: Account disabled and deletion review scheduled. Signing you out…
